chunks: And they stayed in their cave three hundred years and added nine.
ai.seo_question: How long did the Companions of the Cave sleep according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse details the duration of the Companions of the Cave's slumber, noting a total of 309 years which reflects the discrepancy between lunar and solar calendars. Shia scholars, such as Al-Tabarsi, highlight this as a divine sign of precision in timekeeping and resurrection, emphasizing that God alone knows the exact count of their days. The mention of 'and increased by nine' underscores the miraculous nature of their preservation over such a long epoch.
